name: dubai_marina_timelapse
title: Dubai Marina — 8K 360° day-to-night timelapse (original source)
description: Full 4:24 day-to-night equirectangular panoramic timelapse of Dubai Marina, downloaded from YouTube. This is the original source Lana augmented to produce dubai_changing_bgcolors (15s nighttime snippet + animated background hue cycle) and dubai_raining (15s nighttime snippet + rain overlay). Kept for provenance and for any reruns that want to test against the un-augmented source.

label_region.note: Shares dubai_changing_bgcolors/label_mask.png. The mask is 3840x1920 but this source is 3840x2160; arlabelvis.scene.process_scene_video center-pads the mask with zeros up to the frame's 3840x2160 shape (120 rows top + 120 rows bottom). This lands the label at y in [1033, 1308] of the 2160-tall frame, matching where the label sits in the augmented (center-cropped-to-1920) versions per the correlation in data/scenes/_clip_locations.json.

notes: Downloaded via yt-dlp; YouTube video id fTfJwzRsE-w.
The augmented versions in dubai_changing_bgcolors/ and dubai_raining/ are both ~15s nighttime snippets of this source, vertically cropped 2160->1920.
